• Mopa International Airport Takes Flight in Goa*
Goa's newest aviation hub, the Manohar International Airport (also known as Mopa International Airport), has spread its wings and is now operational! This state-of-the-art airport, inaugurated in December 2022, marks a significant development in Goa's tourism and connectivity landscape.
Current Status:
Operational since December 11, 2022
Successfully handling domestic and international flights
Phase 1 caters to approximately 4.4 million passengers annually
Expansion plans in place to accommodate growing passenger traffic in the future
